Faculty have several options for accessibility remediation services through the UVA Library:

*Main accessibility services page*: <https://library.virginia.edu/services/accessibility-services/>

This page covers:
• Media accessibility (audio, video, and print materials)
• Creating accessible audio and video materials
• Print materials: Format conversion

*For instructors - digital accessibility & course materials*: <https://library.virginia.edu/accessibility/course-materials>

Key contacts for faculty:
• **General accessibility questions**: Email lib-a11y@virginia.edu
• **Media accessibility (captioning, audio description)**: Email coaa@virginia.edu
• **SDAC accommodation letters**: If you receive an accommodation notification for a student, email sdacAT@virginia.edu with the inaccessible file(s)

The Library also recommends contacting your *Subject Liaison Librarian* (<https://guides.lib.virginia.edu/subjectlibrarians>) first when looking for more accessible versions of course readings — they can help find digitally accessible alternatives.

For more details on faculty responsibilities regarding AV materials in courses, see the *Video and Media Resources* LibGuide: <https://guides.lib.virginia.edu/c.php?g=514918&p=3572398>
